inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: Need to identify and hire a senior backend engineer with expertise in payments systems, microservices architecture, and financial software development. Must evaluate candidates on technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and experience with payment gateways, fraud detection, and compliance requirements.

define-role.generate.draft:
Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Service

Position Overview:
We are seeking a Senior Backend Engineer to lead our payments service development. This role requires deep expertise in payment systems, microservices architecture, and financial software development.

Key Responsibilities:
- Design, implement, and maintain our core payments service
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate payment solutions
- Ensure compliance with financial regulations and security standards
- Lead technical decisions around payment gateways, fraud detection, and transaction processing
- Mentor junior engineers and contribute to system architecture

Required Skills:
- 5+ years of backend development experience with Java/Go/Python
- Deep understanding of payment systems and financial software
- Experience with microservices architecture and distributed systems
- Knowledge of PCI DSS, fraud detection, and compliance requirements
- Strong problem-solving abilities and system design skills

Preferred:
- Experience with AWS/GCP cloud platforms
- Background in fintech or e-commerce payments
- Knowledge of blockchain or cryptocurrency payment systems

Compensation: Competitive salary + equity + comprehensive benefits package
